newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Trade in Sonae interrupted until Friday.
newsitem.headline: Trade in Sonae interrupted until Friday.

text.p: Trade in shares of Portuguese group Sonae Investimentos has been interrupted from today until February 14 in order to permit the exercise of rights in the restructuring of the company, Lisbon bourse bulletin said.

Under a previously announced restructuring, Sonae Investimentos, which is now the holding company, will control the group's retail and property interests, while wood products group Sonae Industria and Pargeste, the services group, will be incorporated into Inparsa.
Shareholders who hold two shares in Sonae Investimentos have the right to receive one share in Inparsa. Applications for the rights took place from February 17 to March 3.
